name: apprenti.dev Engineering Leadership
audience: Senior engineers and tech leads taking on mentoring, delegation, and cross-team technical decisions; assumes strong implementation skill already
philosophy: Leadership is inspectable work. Write the brief, run the 1:1, record the decision, show the artifact. LEARN BY DOING. GROW THROUGH MENTORSHIP.
aiPrinciples: AI assistance must be disclosed when materially used.
AI may explain, hint, and quiz; it does not generate the briefs, agendas, ADRs, review notes, incident comms, or strategy memos a task asks the apprentice to produce.
The apprentice remains accountable for every recommendation and every named trade-off.
Mentor approval is based on the apprentice's ability to defend the artifact under a changed constraint, not on polish.
